author: TeIq
content:
## Source
.design/m5/44-mobile-app.md — decomposition PR 8.

## Surface
- `docs/ops/mobile-runbook.md` — new operator runbook documenting:
  - How to register a device for push (mobile-app onboarding flow)
  - How to test the push path (CLI command to fire a synthetic P1 escalation)
  - How to revoke a device (admin command: `polaris mobile-revoke --device-id <uuid>`)
  - How to configure APNs (Apple Developer cert, p8 key path)
  - How to configure FCM (Firebase project, service account key)
  - How to configure ntfy.sh (server URL, topic)
  - How to set up `oncall_schedule` entries
  - Troubleshooting: stale token errors, biometric-required failures, deep-link not firing
- New admin command: `polaris mobile-revoke` (sets `mobile_devices.revoked_at`)
- README badge update mentioning the mobile surface

## Rust-quality notes
- Per rust-quality §8 (docs discipline): runbook is markdown intended for operators, not engineers. Use plain language; one section per task; one CLI invocation per code block.
- Doc-comment the admin binary (`#[derive(clap::Parser)]`) with `# Examples` per rust-quality §8.
- CI markdown-lint job (already covers `docs/ops/runbook.md`) extends to the new file. No new tool dep.

## External references
- APNs token-based auth setup: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/usernotifications/establishing_a_token-based_connection_to_apns
- FCM service-account setup: https://firebase.google.com/docs/admin/setup
- ntfy.sh server setup: https://docs.ntfy.sh/install/
- Existing operator runbook (reference style): `docs/ops/runbook.md`

## Acceptance
- [ ] `docs/ops/mobile-runbook.md` exists, ≥150 lines, covers all 8 listed topics.
- [ ] `polaris mobile-revoke --device-id <uuid>` admin command exists with `--help` output.
- [ ] CI markdown-lint passes on the new file.

## Blocks / blocked-by
- Blocked by #121.
- Closes the epic. On approval, close #113 with `--kind result`.
